facts.text: Bella Villa was officially incorporated in 1947, marking its transition from a rural community to an incorporated city.
The city’s two main parks, Elvira Moll Park and George Appel Memorial Park, offer residents green space and community gathering spots.
Geographically, Bella Villa sits between Interstate 55 and Lemay Ferry Road, straddling the northern and southern edges of Bayless Road.
Bella Villa is part of Lemay Township in St. Louis County, placing it within the broader St. Louis metropolitan area.
The city’s name, Bella Villa, reflects a romantic Italian influence, though the exact origin story remains local lore.
Bella Villa’s community center hosts regular events that celebrate local history and foster neighborhood connections.
